notes.title: v1.03 - 02/03/2018
notes.content:
v1.03 - 02/03/2018

* Added clarity text to the reinforcements bar when almost full
* Added reward popup on mission complete
* Raids are easier if many buildings are still damaged
* Assistant warning message no longer plays sound
* Fixed issues with low framerate
* Fixed building being unable to move just one position

- Fixed building being unable to move just one position
